web_search.promptSnippet: Search the live web with explicit, observable provider routing
promptGuidelines: For an ordinary search, omit provider so the configured Brave default is used.
Use web_research normal mode for managed Brave-first search with an observable Perplexity fallback.
For high-stakes or deep research, use web_research cross-check mode to query both providers independently and deduplicate results.
For a known URL, use safe_web_fetch directly instead of spending a search request.
Check result details.selected_provider, fallback_used, and attempts so reports identify which provider actually answered; search snippets are leads, not verified source evidence.
Use the current date for recent queries and cite relevant sources as Markdown links.
An explicit provider override never falls back; if its credential is missing, report the named variable and ask the user to configure it with /web-tools.

web_fetch.promptSnippet: Fetch a known public HTTP(S) URL directly
promptGuidelines: Prefer safe_web_fetch when the URL is already known or after selecting a useful search result.
Cite the fetched URL as a Markdown link in the answer.
Large text may be externalized through the bounded Artifact Store; reopen only its session-scoped artifact URI when ResourceFS is available, never a raw spill path.
